text:
Emma P: Quick sync — Google Marketplace entry for sa-east1 (Brazil) needs quota & billing approval. We have partner-owned listing but Google requires a quota commit for initial 500 CPUs. @Ryan C can you confirm capacity availability?
Ryan C: Checking with infra. We can reserve 200 CPUs in sa-east1 this quarter; to hit 500 we'll need partner burst or new Azure counterpart. Any flexibility on the commit size?
Emma P: Partner wants full 500 for GA. They can't do staged rollout due to go-to-market promise. Marta S, does sales have flexibility on launch date by 2 weeks if we can't get full quota?
Marta S: Delaying 2w is possible but it'll push co-marketing. Partner marketing already scheduled. Not ideal.
Priya O: From ops/security — we need to validate data residency controls in sa-east1. Is there a dedicated network peering plan? Lucas, legal needs an export control check.
Lucas L: I'll review the contract addendum for data residency tonight. If they want dedicated peering we'll need an Appendix B. Also need the partner's SOC2 attestation.
Ryan C: Update from infra: Google quota process expects partner to request via Partner Console and our Marketplace listing needs our billing account ID. We can supply temporary 3-month burst if partner signs a commit for after 90 days.
Emma P: Can we write the commit as: partner covers 3-month ramp, Redwood provides temporary burst to 500 for GA, then monitor actual usage and adjust? Need legal ok.
Lucas L: That structure is ok in principle. Send me a draft of the commit clause. Also require indemnity for misuse in Brazil region.
Marta S: Partner asked about pricing parity across regions — they expect same unit price in sa-east1. Is that supported with different infra cost?
Priya O: Pricing parity is customer facing; we can apply a regional surcharge internally but keep list price same. Ops will surface cost differences in Console billing view.
Ryan C: Infra action: reserving pool now. I'll open quota case with Google — need partner partner-id and listing slug. Emma, can you get those?
Emma P: Looping in partner contacts now. Partner returned partner-id  PA-99821 and listing slug redwood-sae-biz. Sent to Ryan.
Infra Bot: quota_case_opened: case_id=GQ-32415, region=sa-east1, requested=500 CPU, status=pending
Ryan C: Case opened. ETA from Google partner team is 5-7 business days. If approved we'll need Marketplace billing activation steps: provide billing_account_id and finalize SKU mapping.
Emma P: Billing account: 0123-REDWOOD-BILL. Partner needs final SKU mapping by EOD Tuesday.
Marta S: I'll coordinate partner PM to freeze marketing assets until SKU mapping is confirmed. :warning:
Priya O: Ops checklist: peering, IAM roles for partner-managed instances, logging to customer-managed project. I'll attach the template.
Emma P: Sharing the template here:
```yaml
peering: required
iam: partner-infra-service@redwood-infra.iam
logging: enabled -> partner-customer-project
```
Ryan C: Quick test deploy command for partner pre-GA (sandbox):
```bash
rdwctl deploy --region sa-east1 --pool sandbox --image redwood/inference:canary --replicas 2
```
Infra Bot: sandbox_deploy: job=deploy-789 status=success duration=3m12s
Lucas L: One more note — partner's DPA needs an addendum referencing Brazil data residency. I'll send markup in 24h.
Emma P: Great — next steps: (1) Ryan tracks quota case, (2) Lucas finalizes legal addendum, (3) Priya confirms peering template, (4) Marta freezes marketing until SKU mapping. Check back Wednesday for status.
Marta S: Acknowledged. :thumbsup:
Ryan C: I'll update here when Google responds.
Priya O: Scheduling peering dry run for Thursday 10:00 BR time. Invites sent.
Partner Contact (via Emma P): We appreciate the close coordination — looking forward to GA. Asked if Redwood can include a marketplace listing note about regional availability.
Emma P: Noted, marketing will include availability note post SKU mapping.
